text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] OTLP exporter errors -> Honeycomb detected in us-east-1 (5m error rate 37%). Exporter returning 429/503, spans being dropped. auto-escalation to #incidents. thread_ts=1759802468

Maya Chen: I'm on-call. Paging SRE primary and backup now. @PagerDuty Bot please create incident and page Sam. :rotating_light:

PagerDuty Bot: Incident created: INC-2025-314. Assigned to Sam Patel (primary). Escalation policy: SRE-Oncall.

Sam Patel: ACK. I'll start triage. First checks: otel-collector logs and exporter queue metrics. Can someone grab collector logs from us-east?

Ops Bot: kubectl -n infra logs deploy/otel-collector -l region=us-east --since=10m -> streaming

Sam Patel: quick snippet from logs:
```
2025-06-12T14:02:11Z exporter/honeycomb error: failed to send batch: 429 Too Many Requests - quota exceeded
2025-06-12T14:02:12Z exporter queue: enqueue failed: queue full, dropping 1024 spans
2025-06-12T14:03:05Z exporter/honeycomb warn: temporary rate limit, retry after 30s
```

Sam Patel: metrics show exporter_queue_dropped_spans_total=120350 over last 30m, otelcol_exporter_retry_429=840. Looks like vendor-side rate limiting / broker flap.

Jia Li: I'll take the remediation path. Plan: 1) scale otel-collector replicas in us-east, 2) lower sampling for non-critical services to reduce throughput, 3) enable file/local buffer and overflow to S3 as fallback.

Sam Patel: Agreed. Also open support ticket with Honeycomb and ask for ingestion throttling details. I'm drafting message.

Sam Patel: Commands I'm running now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale deploy/otel-collector-us-east --replicas=5
# increase receiver/backpressure capacity
kubectl -n infra exec deploy/otel-collector-us-east -- otelcol-cli stats | grep exporter_queue
```

Ops Bot: rollout started: deployment/otel-collector-us-east scaled to 5 replicas (rolling update).

Sam Patel: Apply temporary sampler change (prod => 0.2, non-prod => 0.5) in otel config. Patch: 
```yaml
processors:
  probabilistic_sampler/svc-high-traffic:
    sampling_percentage: 20.0
  probabilistic_sampler/svc-nonprod:
    sampling_percentage: 50.0
```
kubectl -n infra apply -f otel-sampler-temp-patch.yaml
```

Ops Bot: sampler patch applied to otel-collector configmap, restarting pods to pick up config.

Ava Gomez: Product question — is there any user-facing impact? Do customers see errors? Should we post to status page?

Maya Chen: Short answer: no user-facing API errors. Impact is observability: some traces and spans are missing/dropped, dashboards may show partial traces. We have two customers (org ids 234, 897) who flagged missing spans in their dashboards. Overall estimated lost traces ~2-5% of total; for a handful of services it's up to 30% in last 20m. Severity: P2 (observability degraded). Recommend status update to 'degraded performance for traces'.

Sam Patel: Honeycomb ticket opened: https://help.honeycomb.io/ticket/HC-98765 - Honeycomb acknowledged increased 429s from our account due to downstream ingestion broker over-capacity. They estimate mitigation in 30-60m. They've suggested reducing client-side concurrency and backing off.

Jia Li: Preparing fallback config. Enabling file exporter with disk_queue (max_size 10GB) and awss3 exporter for long-term ingest in case vendor remains throttled. Snippet: 
```yaml
exporters:
  file/local_buffer:
    path: /var/otel-buffer/outgoing.ndjson
  s3/fallback:
    bucket: redwood-otel-backup
    region: us-east-1
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [honeycomb, file/local_buffer]
```
Note: S3 exporter only configured but not active (requires creds rotation).

Sam Patel: Once collectors finish rolling we should see reduced queue droppings. I'm throttling concurrency in the honeycomb exporter by lowering max_concurrency and increasing timeout. Patch applied.

Maya Chen: Customer comms: I'll draft a short status page update: 
- What: Trace export errors to Honeycomb in us-east causing missing spans for some customers.
- Impact: Observability degraded for traces/dashboards; no impact to API or data plane.
- Mitigation: Scaled collectors, lowered sampling, enabled local buffering and opened vendor ticket.
- Next update: 30m or when vendor resolves.

Sam Patel: Handoff to Jia for monitoring and follow-up. Handoff notes: collectors are at 5 replicas, sampler lowered, file exporter enabled, Honeycomb ticket HC-98765 open, vendor ETA ~45m. Watch for drop metrics and honeycomb success responses. If vendor doesn't recover in 60m, flip to S3 fallback (manual) and escalate to EngInfra.

Jia Li: Taking over. I'll be on for the next shift. Ping me in this thread for updates. Setting an alert: otelcol_exporter_dropped_spans_total > 1000/min -> page SRE primary.

Maya Chen: Thanks everyone. I'll post the status update and notify affected customers (org 234 & 897). Will re-open incident if new customer impact appears.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-314 updated: status = monitoring. Keep this thread for handoff notes and postmortem triggers. :white_check_mark:
